title: Enterprise attack-model analysis (real model, verifier-grounded)
purpose: hard security-analyst questions over a real attack model — meaningful security state (footholds, admin, stolen credentials, network reach, exfiltration) and attack techniques with preconditions, defences as constants — not a flat attack graph. Ground truth is the Z3 verifier / model semantics: shortest attack plan, reachability under a defence set, minimum defences to stop exfiltration, technique applicability.

tasks.purpose: reachability on a real attack model (20 state vars)
tasks.question: With the deployed defences above in place, can the attacker still reach data exfiltration?

tasks.purpose: shortest_cost on a real attack model (20 state vars)
tasks.question: With no defences deployed, what is the minimum number of techniques the attacker must use to reach data exfiltration? Count every technique, including the final exfiltration step.
